fused_max.followup: Four alternating packed-residual/fused-max runs, 7 reps, budgets 6 and 21, queued; do not infer small differences.

method: Only record=rep rows are used. For paired experiments, control is the arithmetic mean of the two bracket-run per-configuration medians; candidate delta is 100*(candidate/control-1), so negative means faster. Phase is total_s. Fault counts are medians. Warmups and CSV summary rows are excluded.
